label: r06-multi-write
command: cat go.mod > w1.txt; cat README.txt > w2.txt; cat go.mod >> w1.txt; wc -c w1.txt w2.txt

label: r07-refuse-mid
command: echo before; ls go.mod; eval 'echo inner'; echo after

label: r10-sed-bak
command: sed -i.bak 's/alpha/ALPHA/' docs/nested/list.txt && cat docs/nested/list.txt && ls docs/nested

label: r12-set-e
command: set -euo pipefail; echo ok; false; echo notreached

label: r13-pwd-env
command: echo "PWD=$PWD"; pwd; cd docs && pwd && echo "OLD=$OLDPWD"

label: r16-bg-native-sleep
command:
sleep 30 &
echo "bg=$!"
jobs
kill %1
wait
echo "waited=$?"
jobs

label: r19-tee
command: echo teed | tee tee2.txt && cat tee2.txt

label: r20-touch-r
command: touch -r go.mod t1.txt && touch t2.txt && ls -l t1.txt t2.txt

label: r27-jq-rename
command: jq '.y = .x | del(.x)' config.json > config.json.tmp && mv config.json.tmp config.json && cat config.json

label: r28-git
command: git status --short; git log --oneline -3; git diff --stat

label: r30-which-type
command: which jq; type grep; command -v sed; which curl git

label: r36-printf-tr-cut
command: printf '%s:%d\n' a 1 b 2 | tr a-z A-Z | cut -d: -f1

label: r37-test-forms
command: test -f go.mod && echo f1; [ -d internal ] && echo d1; [[ -f main.go ]] && echo f2; [ -e nope ] || echo e0

label: r39-heredoc-wc

cat <<EOF | wc -l
one
